beats.summary: Dwight Schrute is announced as the new manager and Jim negotiates to be assistant to the regional manager.
Andy decides to pursue his dream of acting and wants to burn his fallback by having Toby mark him as fired for theft or groping.

evidence.snippet:
David Wallace: Attention, everyone, just a quick announcement. Little reconfiguration to the staff. Dwight Schrute—
Dwight: David. Can I just do one thing while you're making this announcement and then I'll never, ever do it again?
David Wa

beats.summary: Toby refuses to lie about Andy's firing, leading to Andy touching Toby's thighs to persuade him.

evidence.snippet: Toby: Andy, you know I can't do that. It'd be lying.
Andy: God, Toby, don't—stop blocking my hand.

beats.summary: Andy expresses frustration with the company and his boss David Wallace, culminating in him defecating on David's car.

evidence.snippet: [STAGE] clip of Andy taking a dump on a car

beats.summary: Andy sings 'I Will Remember You' as a farewell performance, impressing some coworkers.

evidence.snippet: [STAGE] sings 'I Will Remember You'—everyone is slightly impressed
